units.source_text: 不過，實際上我卻一直抱著如履薄冰的心態與她們打交道，她們的心思難以捉摸。

en.t: Even so, in reality I had always dealt with them as though treading on thin ice, for their thoughts were impossible to fathom.

units.source_text: 有時，身陷在五里霧中，如同踩住了老虎尾巴，慘遭失敗，

en.t: At times I would find myself lost in a dense fog, and, as if stepping on a tiger's tail, suffer a disastrous failure,

units.source_text: 與來自男性的鞭撻不同，彷彿內出血讓人產生極度的不快感，是很難治癒的內傷。

en.t: unlike the lashes dealt by men, it was like internal bleeding, producing an intense discomfort and leaving an inner wound very hard to heal.

units.source_text: 女人有時會將我一把拽到身邊，有時又將我甩開冷眼相待，

en.t: Women would sometimes pull me suddenly close to them, and at other times fling me away and treat me with cold disdain,

units.source_text: 甚至在眾目睽睽之下藐視我、羞辱我，誰都不在時，又緊緊地摟住我。

en.t: even despising and humiliating me in front of everyone, only to hold me tightly when no one else was there.

units.source_text: 女人像死去一樣酣睡，彷彿為睡而生。

en.t: Women sleep soundly, as if dead, as though they were born for the sake of sleeping.
